<action type="say">
If this is your normal personal login and a long-standing checking account, then the fact that nothing is showing usually means one of three things on the bank’s side:  
- The account somehow got unlinked from your online profile  
- There’s a technical outage or sync issue for your profile  
- There’s a restriction or hold on the account that’s hiding it in digital channels

Here are the best next steps you can take yourself right now:

1) Try a quick sign‑out / sign‑in and another channel  
- Fully sign out of the app or website, close it, then sign in again.  
- If you’re on the app, also try logging in via the bank’s website in a browser (or vice versa) to see if the account appears there.  
- If the bank offers a “Profile” or “Accounts & Settings” page, check if there’s an option like “Linked accounts,” “Hide/show accounts,” or “Account display preferences” — make sure your checking isn’t accidentally hidden.

2) Check for any alerts or messages  
- Look for notifications, secure messages, or banners in your account that mention: “account access,” “profile update,” “restricted account,” or “maintenance.”  
- Sometimes banks temporarily hide accounts if ID verification or contact info updates are required.

3) Contact the bank and tell them exactly this  
If the above doesn’t fix it, you’ll want to contact support (phone or secure chat). You can say something like:  
- “My personal checking account that I use every day isn’t showing at all in online banking under my usual login. Can you confirm the account is still linked to this online profile and that there are no restrictions or technical issues on my user ID?”  

Ask them specifically to:  
- Verify that your checking account is **active** and in good standing.  
- Confirm it is **linked to your current online banking user ID**.  
- Check for any **holds, restrictions, or system errors** affecting digital visibility.  
They can usually relink it or fix a back‑end issue on the spot.

While we sort this out:  
- If you have a recent statement, ATM access, or debit card tied to that checking account, you can still see/withdraw your balance there until online banking is fixed.

To help narrow it down a bit more, can you tell me:  
1) Are you using the bank’s **mobile app or website** right now (and have you tried the other one)?  
2) When you log in, do you see **anything at all** (like a dashboard with $0 accounts, or literally “no accounts found”)?</action>

> “I’m having an issue where my online banking shows ‘no accounts available.’ While that’s being looked at, can you please tell me my current balance and available balance on my personal checking account ending in XXXX?”

> “It’s my main personal checking account connected to my debit card. Can you pull that up and give me the current and available balance?”
